'''Stir Fry''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients and homemade [[Oil]].
